verdicts.rationale: attachContinuation supplies the outstanding-request condition and all three deferred-turn fields; deferredContinuationResult supplies the state, empty publications, prompt and requested observation. Both bodies are needed and neither member is redundant.

The truncation handler establishes the utilization/first-retry decision, compaction/failure branches and unchanged iteration; publishedRetryOrdinal establishes the parse, loop/iteration match and zero fallback. The two bodies fully support the answer and are individually insufficient.

The gate refusal and errors.As handling are supported, but the gold bodies do not establish the claimed effect-free terminalGuardResult or HandleToolResult early return: those bodies lie outside the set. The answer therefore needs more than the two named members to be established in full.

dispatchToolCall explicitly describes and implements overwriting the enforced cached keys on every dispatch path, while restoreLoopFromRequest implements the defensive record-metadata copy and explains the permissive missing-key hazard. Both different-file members are necessary.

SettleRequest alone shows locking, the outstanding-settlement call, the nonempty carrier-match guard and all three clears. The actual settleTruncatedRequest lookalike only settles outstanding work; TrackRequest writes the carrier instead of clearing it.

truncateToolResult alone supplies the exact marker, byte budget, marker-only fallback and UTF-8 rune-start walk. The cited oversized-result call confirms its use, and the real model-response diagnostic/truncation helpers do not supply this tool-result marker.
